name: Again With the Zapped Giants
label: Quest
description: Zorbin Fandazzle knows you have already gathered residue, but can always use more. The Ultra-Shrinker is yours to use once more on the giants of Feralas…
intro: Zorbin Fandazzle knows you have already gathered residue, but can always use more. The Ultra-Shrinker is yours to use once more on the giants of Feralas, and Zorbin waits by the Forgotten Coast docks. Zorbin cannot pay nearly as much this time, but promises to spread word of your service.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I know you've gathered residue for me already... But should you find yourself for want of an encore performance to a fun-time activity, I can always use more residue.
While I can't offer nearly as much in the way of compensation again, I'll be more than happy to spread the good word of your service to all my goblin friends with ears.
Believe me friend when I say that these goblins have quite large ears.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, the fruits of research and utilization in the form of sweet, sweet residue. Well, that is to say, I don't taste it or anything when I study it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Inconceivably fantastical, friend! You've come through for me again, and for that I thank you.

While you may find this coin to be a little less than you're accustomed to, rest assured your great deeds on the field of goblindom are echoing through the halls of power in the Steamwheedle Cartel. Should you need something else to do, then by all means talk to me!
